name: LUBEREF
method: Every file scanned page by page (sha256 recomputed = inventory). Statement pages of the four annuals and the 2026 interims are image-only pages inside text PDFs: rendered and read by eye; arithmetic re-added; cross-document reconciliation Q1+Q2=H1, retained-earnings roll, FY2024 original vs FY2025 comparative, FY2022/FY2023 originals vs restated comparatives.

dimension_1_value_correctness.verdict: extractable_and_verified for FY2025, H1 2026, Q1 2026 (full BS/P&L/CF page-read, all arithmetic exact) and for FY2024, FY2023, FY2022 balance sheet and P&L (+FY2024 CF); not read for the other interims.
verified: FY2025 (4eed9d64 pdf p7/8/10/11): total assets 7,606,399; equity 4,582,446; revenue 8,103,355; profit 855,315; CFO 1,517,527; closing cash 987,383 = SOFP.
Q1 2026 (a0a0c75c pdf p4/5/7): total assets 8,818,411; revenue 2,158,407; profit 257,968; Q1+Q2 profit = H1 exactly; retained earnings roll Q1 2,616,584 + Q2 734,097 - OCI 22,200 = 3,328,481.
FY2024 original (15ef1d81): equals FY2025 comparatives (cash-flow lines regrouped, totals equal). FY2023 (e6e47c2c) and FY2022 (bcc3ba10) balance sheets and P&L read.
not_read: FY2023/FY2022 cash flows, all other interims (2022-2025)
dimension_1_value_correctness.currency_units: FY2025/FY2024/FY2023 and 2023-2026 interims: SAR thousands. FY2022 ORIGINAL (bcc3ba10): FULL SAR ('All amounts in Saudi Riyals'), restated in thousands in the FY2023 file.
hazards: Unit scale differs between files: FY2022 original in full SAR vs thousands elsewhere.
FY2022 comparatives restated in FY2023 file (gross profit 2,433,686 vs 2,503,755 original; profit unchanged), FY2021 also 'Restated'.
Statutory reserve (506,250) eliminated by 2025-12-31 (transfer to retained earnings), Arabic copy of Q1 2026 uses Arabic-Indic digits.

dimension_2_document_completeness.verdict: All 19 statement documents (18 distinct periods + the Arabic duplicate) are Luberef (company name on covers). 2022 H1 is 'special purpose' audited statements of a limited liability company (pre-IPO, 56 pages, image statements); 2022 9M/Q1 are condensed interims of the pre-IPO entity. dc221bc3 is an ARABIC translation of Q1 2026 (issuer site), not a separate period; a0a0c75c is the Saudi Exchange English copy. 5 results decks (0be46a5e, a5231d2e, 910b1203, f1589ee1, 7bf40336) were mis-kinded by the text classifier; 8 decks/releases in total are non-statement.
dimension_2_document_completeness.label_defects: SE statement PDFs labelled with publication year: bcc3ba10 '2023|FY' = FY2022; e6e47c2c '2024|FY' = FY2023; 15ef1d81 '2025|FY' = FY2024; 4eed9d64 '2026|FY' = FY2025. The inventory then records 2022|FY as 'non-statement only' (1-page results release 42568f0e) although FY2022 statements exist, and counts the FY2024 file as FY2025.

dimension_3_company_coverage.verdict: Collected: Q1 2022 to H1 2026 every quarter/half/9M plus FY2022-FY2025, 18 of 18 periods each with a statement document (Luberef listed 2022-12-28; earlier history is a private company). The pre-IPO 2022 interims are on a different legal basis.
dimension_3_company_coverage.inventory_correction: Inventory 8 complete / 6 partial / 1 non-statement: after label correction all FY2022-FY2025 are present and the 'partial' cases are mostly image statement pages.

inventory_flag_confirmations: CORRECTED: '2022|FY non_statement_only': the real FY2022 statements are bcc3ba10 (labelled 2023|FY).
CONFIRMED: dc221bc3 language ar (inventory 'bilingual_or_mixed' hides the Arabic duplication).
CORRECTED: results decks mis-kinded as financial statements (0be46a5e, a5231d2e, 910b1203).
